action: Intro: finished Okarun/Turbo Granny bust (skull-face half, glasses, huge tooth mask, feather-like hair) shown on an XPPen pen display; sponsor title card and glove.
why: Shows the target of the sketch before the process

action: Start of the face sketch: a smooth bald head whose face is already cut into broad flat planes (flat cheek side plane, wedge nose ridge, pointed V chin) with a separate-looking ear blob he refines with a small brush.
tool: DynaMesh head; planar trims inferred from the flat facets; small round brush on the ear
why: Anime face read comes from a few big planes and a pointed chin before any detail
reader_equivalent: Voxel-remeshed sphere; bisect/Line Project or Flatten/Scrape for planes; Grab + Draw for ear

action: Masks two flat almond eye shapes on the face (pale masked areas) and works through them; nose tip and a small mouth line are pinched in; ears pulled out on the sides.
tool: MaskPen/MaskLasso (shelf shows MaskPe, MaskLa); makkon/SO_Det type crease brushes in shelf
why: Eye sockets and lids are placed as flat masked shapes, not modelled eyeballs
reader_equivalent: Mask brush or Lasso Mask + Draw/Crease; Pinch for nose tip

action: Upper lids carved as thin sharp ledges (long horizontal slits above each eye), brow lines drawn on the forehead as sketch lines, small nose and narrow mouth.
tool: crease/dam-type brush (inferred from sharp thin cut)
why: Anime lid = one crisp overhanging line, eye kept closed/blank at sketch stage
reader_equivalent: Crease brush (sharp) or Draw Sharp along the lid line

action: Uses a rotated mask shape (on-screen 'MASK Angle=40') to mask the hairline region over the forehead/scalp after sketching hair-flow lines on the skull.
tool: Mask rect/lasso brush with angle readout; DynaMesh panel visible
why: Mask defines the hair cap area so it can be pulled/extruded separately from the face
reader_equivalent: Box/Lasso Mask in sculpt mode, then Mask Extract or Grab on unmasked region

action: Pulls the whole hair mass up out of the skull into one long tapered spike (single big swept volume) with lock grooves running along it.
tool: Move / Snake Hook (inferred from the long pulled taper)
why: Blocks hair as one big flame-like mass first to set the silhouette
reader_equivalent: Snake Hook / Grab on a masked hair cap, then Crease for lock lines

action: Adds a separate low-poly faceted strip (hard planar sides, pointed tip) as a single fringe lock across the forehead and adjusts it with a numeric readout near the pen.
tool: separate low-poly lock mesh (ZModeler/insert-type, inferred); readout '01.38..' visible
why: Fringe locks are separate hard-edged pieces laid over the scalp, not sculpted out of the head
reader_equivalent: Separate object: low-poly strip/curve with bevel, edited in Edit Mode, then Subdivision Surface or remesh

action: Outro on the finished model (skull face detail, red-painted eye) with 'Stay tuned to the next video' caption.
